rows.text: Finally, the moment has come. Your cloak flaps in the sandy wind, and you will soon be facing the *ancient brain*.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You need to carry your Device Assistant with you to ensure you maintain a normal mental state. Yes... the *ancient brain* will affect your consciousness.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You throw a Molotov cocktail at it... and succeed! It seems like the *ancient brain* loves piping hot delicacies.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Watching its body melt, a fun idea pops up in your head: You should prepare some "appetizers" to go with the course you just fed it next time...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You've failed! You slip and fall right in front of the *ancient brain*!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You have no choice but to cover your retreat with a Molotov cocktail... All your previous effort has gone down the drain! While retreating, the thought of having to start everything over leaves you frustrated!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
